EmailTemplate.name: Event Spotlight West Communication Invite Email
EmailTemplate.subject: You're invited to Spotlight West!
EmailTemplate.textOnly:
Hello {!Contact.FirstName},
Are you interested in majoring in communication? Join us for ASU Spotlight West: Communication.
This special visit for transfer students will give you a deeper dive into our communication majors at Arizona State University’s West campus. Enjoy a campus tour, hear from students and faculty, discover our vibrant Barrett, The Honors College community and enjoy lunch in our Verde Dining Pavilion.
Spotlight West: Communication
Arizona State University, West campus
Friday, October 30
Check-in: 9:30 – 10 a.m.
Program: 10 a.m. – 1:30 p.m.
RSVP at https://visit.asu.edu/spotlightwest.
At this event, you will also get to tour the Communication Assessment and Learning Lab (C.A.L.L.). We are one of only 12 institutions in the U.S. that has this type of communication lab.
If you have any questions, please email visitASU@asu.edu. If you need a special accommodation, let us know at least two weeks before the event.
We’re looking forward to showing your our communication programs at Spotlight West.
{!User.Recruiter_Full_Name__c} Admission Services {!User.Recruiter_Title__c} {!User.Recruiter_Email__c} {!User.Recruiter_Phone__c}
If you have any additional information or questions related to this, please reply to this email.
